name: KiezKram Flohmarkt in den Heynhöfen
facts: neighbourhood flea market in the Heynhöfe, a creative commercial courtyard in Pankow
only second-hand things from private owners; no commercial selling
sellers do not sell food or drink; there is food on site
notes: The organiser's page is a seller-registration page; it lists two dates, 11.10 and 08.11.2026, both 12:00–18:00 (separate event page for 8 Nov). Rhythm is not stated — both are second Sundays, but that is not claimed. 'Second-hand from private owners only', 'no food or drink sales by sellers' and 'catering on site' (sellers get discount cards for it) come from the exhibitor agreement PDF linked on that page (Ausstellervereinbarung_KiezKram_V02.pdf, heynhoefe.de). Not stated: indoor or outdoor, visitor entry fee (null), number of stalls. October seller places are sold out. The directory calls it 'Fritz-Heyn-Höfe'; the organiser says Heynhöfe. Looks like a young series — only two dates ever shown. Coordinates: Heynstraße 15 from Nominatim. Re-checked 2026-10-10: unchanged — 11.10 (seller registration closed, sold out) and 08.11, both 12:00–18:00.

description.de: Ein Kiezflohmarkt in den Heynhöfen, einem kreativen Gewerbehof in Pankow. Hier verkaufen nur Privatleute Gebrauchtes aus dem eigenen Bestand, gewerbliche Händler sind nicht dabei. Zu essen gibt es vor Ort.
description.en: A neighbourhood flea market in the Heynhöfe, a creative commercial courtyard in Pankow. Only private people sell here, with second-hand things of their own; there are no professional traders. Food is available on site.
